title: Authorities seize P17.55-M ‘smuggled’ cigarettes in Maguindanao del Norte
summary: COTABATO CITY – Police and Marine troops seized 300 master cases of suspected smuggled cigarettes worth P17.55 million during a hot pursuit operation in Parang, Maguindanao del Norte, on Monday…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Police and Marine troops seized 300 master cases of suspected smuggled cigarettes worth P17.55 million during a hot pursuit operation in Parang, Maguindanao del Norte, on Monday afternoon, Oct. 19. Citing report from Parang Municipal Police Station, Brig. Gen. Christopher Abecia, regional director for Police Regional Office-Bansamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), said the cigarettes were recovered from a white wing van truck inside a compound used for buying and selling coconuts in Barangay Nituan at around 1:30 p.m. READ: P4.3M in smuggled cigarettes seized in Negros Occidental Lt.
